title: New time-periodic solutions to the cubic conformal wave equation on $\mathbb{S}^{3}$: I Spherical symmetry
summary: We present a rigorous construction of novel time-periodic solutions to the radially symmetric cubic conformal wave equation on the Einstein cylinder $\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{S}^{3}$. Their existence, hinted by the earlier numerical studies (arXiv:2504.10513), complements prior results on Cantor sets of infinitesimally small solutions. Our proof, based on the contraction principle, requires extensive computations that are performed on a computer by the means of rational arithmetic.
